svg.title: TARGET-DENSITY CANARY — NOT GEOGRAPHY
svg.desc: Not geography, and it claims none. A synthetic sheet at the agreed target density (13 landmasses, 160 regions, 1740 landform instances, 340 labels) on the atlas sheet's own 400 km frame, built by tools/mapforge/lib/synthetic-sheet.mjs so a render regression at scale is visible before the real world exists.
